preprocessing.determinism: no randomness and no learned parameters; the same corpus rebuilds byte-identically
preprocessing.tokenizer: casefold, [a-z][a-z0-9-]{2,}, shared stopword list, no stemming
preprocessing.weighting: tf=1+log(count), idf=log((N+1)/(df+1))+1, L2-normalised; score is cosine similarity in [0,1]

provider.external_transmission: none: the phenotype text and the corpora never leave this machine
provider.upgrade_path: an embedding backend is a provider swap: build a new index with its own database_version and model_version; existing frozen retrievals stay valid and comparable only within their own database

safety: the index holds reference records only; no QTL interval, candidate id, or private sequence enters it
rows without a family/orthogroup or without a source id are excluded before Top-K and kept in a ledger
retrieval similarity computed from this index is a discovery route, never causal evidence
source_backed: every indexed row carries a source_id; rows without one are excluded, never indexed
